defect.description: The http adapter installs a once-per-socket 'error' listener whose closure retains the request context that was installing it; on pooled keep-alive sockets that get reassigned, the retained context leaks (memory leak).
defect.provenance: fix PR #11091 title and summary (commit e8147e6)
